<subject>Reminder -- Last Day to Provide Input on Naming of Meridian's New Wellness Centre!</subject>
<body>
As Meridian finalizes plans for our wellness centre scheduled to open during Q3 next year, we are seeking input on 5 alternative names/concepts for the naming of our facility. If you've already given feedback, THANKS!

If you have not, please take 5 minutes of your time to stop by Floor 12, Meeting Room B from 11-1 TODAY to give us your opinion.

Feel free to bring a colleague! FREE refreshments will be provided!

Please forward this email to any other Meridian employees that may want to provide their input on the naming of the centre.

We look forward to seeing you later today!

Regards,

Grace Elliott
Executive Assistant
Meridian Law & Advisory LLP
London, UK
+44 (0)20 7946 0958
</body>
